name: Customer response
description: Draft a concise, evidence-grounded customer response for Synthetix.
instructions: Draft a concise response using only supplied facts. Separate confirmed facts from assumptions, include an owner and due date for every action, and never invent commitments.

name: PII redaction
description: Redact common personal identifiers before text is sent to an agent.
instructions: Run scripts/redact.py against input text. Return the redacted text and a count by identifier type. Never echo an original identifier in logs or output.

name: Secure code review
description: Apply the shared engineering review checklist in coding agents.
instructions: Review for correctness, security, reliability, and missing tests. Lead with concrete findings ordered by severity and cite file paths and lines.
